task.description:
git checkout feature/WF03-ISS0720-20260919 first. Write a fail-then-pass regression test proving ISS-0720's fix, per docs/agents/workflows/WF-03_issue_resolving.md Step 4's requirement: the test must be shown to FAIL against the pre-fix code and PASS against the post-fix code (checked out via a separate commit/worktree comparison, or reasoned via a mutation if the pre-fix state is awkward to check out -- your call, but the fail-first proof must be real and stated in your summary, not asserted).

Core regression test: set Application.put_env(:letflow, :oidc, keycloak_base_url: "https://iss0720-regression-test-authority.example") (restoring the original value in on_exit/1), ensure BPM_IDP_BASE_URL and KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL system env vars are NOT set during this test (use System.delete_env/put_env with on_exit restore, or confirm test env never sets them -- check first), then GET /api/tenant-config and assert the response's oidc_authority starts with "https://iss0720-regression-test-authority.example/realms/". Against PRE-FIX code (which reads the retired :issuer key, always nil, so falls through to the compiled localhost default since env vars are unset), this assertion fails -- the response would show localhost:8082, not the configured keycloak_base_url. Against POST-FIX code, it passes. This directly discriminates the exact bug ISS-0720/T-0138/ISS-0719 describes.

Also cover: the REVIEWER-flagged constraint that the new @allow_localhost_idp_fallback? compile-time flag cannot be runtime-toggled via Application.put_env/3 -- do not attempt to test the raise branch by flipping that flag at runtime; if you want coverage of the raise path, state explicitly in your summary why it either can or cannot be practically unit-tested given the compile-time mechanism, and if it cannot, that is an acceptable, explicitly-stated gap (not a step failure) since the flag's own correctness (false in prod/runtime.exs, true in dev/test.exs) was independently verified by SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER already via direct config-file inspection.

Add the test to test/letflow/routers/tenant_config_test.exs (existing file, artifacts_in) as new test case(s), following that file's existing conventions.
acceptance_criteria: New test in test/letflow/routers/tenant_config_test.exs asserts oidc_authority reflects a custom configured keycloak_base_url when BPM_IDP_BASE_URL/KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL are unset
Fail-then-pass proof is real and stated: confirmed FAIL against pre-fix tenant_config.ex, confirmed PASS against post-fix
Test cleans up any Application.put_env/System.put_env changes in on_exit/1, verified not to leak into other tests
Explicit statement on whether/why the compile-time-gated raise path is or isn't separately unit-testable

result.summary: Added a regression test to test/letflow/routers/tenant_config_test.exs (describe 'ISS-0720: oidc_authority reflects configured :keycloak_base_url, not the retired :issuer key') plus test/specs/ISS-0720.md. The test sets Application.put_env(:letflow, :oidc, ...) with a distinctive keycloak_base_url (https://iss0720-regression-test-authority.example), restored via on_exit/1, confirms BPM_IDP_BASE_URL/KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL are unset in this test env (refute System.get_env/1 -- confirmed both nil), calls GET /api/tenant-config through Letflow.Router, and asserts oidc_authority starts with the configured host + '/realms/' and never contains 'localhost'. FAIL-THEN-PASS PROOF (real, executed, not asserted): (1) Post-fix baseline: `mix test test/letflow/routers/tenant_config_test.exs` -> 'Result: 11 passed'. (2) Pre-fix repro: replaced lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex in the working tree with `git show 1fd89bb1:lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex` (1fd89bb1 is the immediate parent of fix commit dbcc89e2), test file and config/dev.exs+test.exs left untouched, reran the same test file -> 'Result: 10/11 passed', the ISS-0720 test the sole failure: 'Expected truthy, got false ... # 1 "http://localhost:8082/realms/bpm-default" # 2 "https://iss0720-regression-test-authority.example/realms/"' -- exactly the ISS-0720/ISS-0719 symptom (configured keycloak_base_url ignored, compiled localhost default leaks through). (3) Restored lib/letflow/routers/tenant_config.ex to the post-fix version; `git diff` on it came back empty (exact restore confirmed); reran -> 'Result: 11 passed' again. (4) Ran `mix letflow.check.test` (forces fresh warnings-as-errors recompile of the full suite, not just this file) -> 'mix letflow.check.test: OK -- isolated :lua_wallclock_race run also passed clean.', exit code 0, no 'default values for the optional arguments' substring present. COMPILE-TIME RAISE-PATH STATEMENT: the @allow_localhost_idp_fallback? flag on default_idp_base_url!/0's raise branch is resolved once at compile time via Application.compile_env/3 (mirrors Letflow.Repository.Activation's @activation_test_hooks_enabled? pattern) -- Application.put_env/3 cannot change an already-compiled module attribute at runtime, and config/test.exs compiles this suite with the flag permanently true, so the raise branch is NOT reachable/unit-testable from within this same test.exs-compiled suite; exercising it would require a separate build/MIX_ENV with allow_localhost_idp_fallback unset. This is an explicitly accepted gap per the design doc's own §5 item 3 and REVIEWER's step-03c next_action, not a step failure -- the flag's own correctness (false in prod/runtime.exs, true in dev/test.exs) was already independently verified by SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER via direct config-file inspection. Leakage check: grepped the full test/ tree for any other test asserting on the literal keycloak_base_url host inside oidc_authority (localhost + oidc_authority/keycloak_base_url patterns) -- none found, so this test's temporary global Application env mutation (kept in this async: true file per the task's instruction to follow the file's existing convention) cannot collide with another test's literal-value assertion; on_exit/1 restores the original :oidc keyword list unconditionally.
